sw_text_raw: When the EMPIRE has roll call, we get\nimportant guard posts in the order\lthat we line up.\pThat's why I'm stuck off in this corner.\nI'm always late to roll call!$

LORD VADER told us to dig into
MUSTAFAR PEAK, so we dug and dug.\pAnd in the course of digging, we came
across something that blew our minds!\pWhat did we find?\pFuhahaha!
I'll tell you if you beat me!$

What, what, what?\pOnly EMPIRE troops are supposed
to be in here!\pBut you're not wearing the EMPIRE's
armor…\pYou rouse my suspicion!
Battle with me!$
Aiyiyi…\nMy pride as a STORMTROOPER…$
If you suffer from chills, you should\njoin the EMPIRE. It's warm here.$
We dug up something beyond belief!\nAnd, we got the BLUE KYBER!\pAll that's left is for LORD VADER to…\nFufufu… Fwahahaha!$
I can't stand heat. Maybe I should've\njoined the CARTEL instead…$
Yeah, I really may not be right for\nthe EMPIRE…$
Don't you miss fresh air, being\nin a place like this?$
You can hear tremors here sometimes.\pCould it be the volcano rattling?\nOr is it GREAT…\pWhoops!\nNo, no, never mind!$
You just happened to win this time,\nbut that doesn't matter.\pThe EMPIRE's goal is about to be\nreached!$
Do you think it's odd that we wear\nfull armor in a lava-filled fortress?$

We serve LORD VADER and his vision
of order.\pI don't care if you're with the CARTEL
or if you're just some kid passing by.\pNo one interferes with us and gets
away with it!$
Listen to me.\nThe EMPIRE is right!\pDon't listen to the CARTEL.\nDon't believe their lies!$

I follow every order LORD VADER
gives. But you know what?\pDoing stuff like digging up a super-
ancient COMPANION and ripping off\lsomeone's METEORITE…\pI think we're going a little too far.
What do you think?$
You know, losing to you cleared my mind.\pThe next time I see LORD VADER…\nWell… Maybe I'll keep quiet.$
LORD VADER!\nAn intruder is headed your way!$

Hehehe!
You made it this far, so I'll tell you!\pThat's right!
Up ahead, GREATKRAYT is sleeping!\pLORD VADER went to GREATKRAYT just
seconds ago!\pIt's going to awaken real soon!
Hehe! Hehehe!$
…And while you wasted time with me,\nLORD VADER will have awakened\nGREATKRAYT…$
VADER: So. It was you.\pI have sensed you poking around\nuninvited here and there…\pI see it now.\nYou have used the Force against me!$
The Force is strong with you…\nStronger than I had foreseen.$
notes: Vader's second loss: he senses the player's Force strength

sw_text_raw:
VADER: There has to be some reason
why GREATKRAYT fled…\pThat's what you're trying to say,
isn't it?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pYou think I did not know that?\pWith GREATKRAYT gone, I have no
further need for this volcano.\pI am going after GREATKRAYT.
This is where we part!$
All sorts of beings wander the slopes\nof the JEDHA TEMPLE…\pThere is no telling what may happen.\nTake this. It's for your own good.$
Did you come to pay your respects\nto the spirits of departed COMPANIONS?\pYou must care for your COMPANIONS a\nlot.$
Hey! Are you hunting COMPANIONS?\nYou followed my trail! You're rude!$
Our family has been TRAINERS here\nsince my great-grandmother's time…\pIt is my duty to protect this\ntemple…$
The Force is strong in this holy\nplace. I have walked it for years.\pCome, child. Show me what guides\nyou.$

COMPANIONS no longer of this world.
COMPANIONS that are with you now.\pAnd the COMPANIONS you will meet
in the future…\pThey are all to be equally cherished.
Please remember that.$

COMPANIONS no longer of this world.
COMPANIONS that are with you now.\pAnd the COMPANIONS you will meet
in the future…\pThey are all to be equally cherished.
I see that you've remembered that.$
I would like to see your COMPANIONS\nwhen they grow up some more…\pPlease, I need to see your COMLINK.$
Perhaps the power is from the spirits\nof COMPANIONS in fitful sleep here…$
The COMPANIONS at rest here…\nSometimes, they play…$
No! Those EMPIRE goons got\nhere ahead of us!\pWe can't fall behind!$
I thought you were one of the\nSTORMTROOPERS coming back…$

Hah!
Too bad for you!\pIf you came earlier, you only would've
had to battle the wimpy EMPIRE.\pBut since you arrived now, you have
to take on us toughies!$
Urgh… I should've let you take on\nthe EMPIRE first…$
You…\nWe saw you at MUSTAFAR PEAK.\pYou're not EMPIRE or CARTEL,\nso why would you be here?$
If you're going to mess with anyone,\nlet it be the EMPIRE…$
Heh, it doesn't matter!\nWe bought ourselves some time!\pThe mighty JABBA should have snatched\nwhat he was after!$
Oh, I know!\nYou tried to join the EMPIRE,\lbut they wouldn't have you!\pWell, don't think that we'll let you\njoin the CARTEL!$
If you want to join the CARTEL that\nbadly, we can consider it…$
We have a great thing going with\nus thugs and the mighty JABBA.$

JABBA: The EMPIRE's VADER got ahead
of us, but we also got what we wanted.\pThe RED KYBER kept at JEDHA TEMPLE…
I, JABBA, now have it in my possession!\pHo ho ho… Now every dry world will
become a swamp fit for a HUTT!\pCome, my thugs!
We're pulling out!$

Oh, no…
This cannot happen…\pNot only the BLUE KYBER, but even
the RED KYBER has been taken…\pThe BLUE and RED KYBER must never
be separated. They belong together.\pWhat are those men trying to do with
the two crystals?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pOh, yes. Was it the EMPIRE who came
and took the BLUE KYBER first?\pWell, in their haste, they left this
behind.\pI couldn't imagine what exactly it
could be.\pI would like you to have it.
Perhaps it will be useful in some way.$

Oh, my goodness…\pYou say GREATKRAYT and SANDO
have both been awakened?\pIt is said that the BLUE KYBER and
the RED KYBER quelled the rage of\lthe two COMPANIONS…\pIt is also said that the true owner
of the crystals still exists.\pHowever, no one knows who, or what
exactly, the crystals belong to.\pIt could be a human, or perhaps
a COMPANION, but no one knows.$
The two who took the crystals came\nback to return them on their own.\pThose men…\nPerhaps they are not so evil after all…$

The embodiments of the land, sea,
and the stars…\pThat is said to be the identities of
the super-ancient COMPANIONS…\pIn the same way that we humans and
COMPANIONS have life, every world, too,\lis alive…\pThe super-ancient COMPANIONS have
taught us that…$

Here at the TEMPLE we calm the
spirits of departed COMPANIONS…\pThis is a high place where one can
see the stars of the OUTER RIM…\pThe disembodied spirits of COMPANIONS
must find solace here…\pIs it coincidence that you are here…\pWill you hear out my tale? A tale long
told in the OUTER RIM region?$

It happened long, long ago…\pThe worlds were wracked by a ferocious
clash between the COMPANION of the\lland and the COMPANION of the sea…\pThe COMPANION of the land raised
mountains and dried up the seas…\pThe COMPANION of the sea raised huge
waves and drowned the lands…\pTheir fierce duel raged without end.\pThe worlds were engulfed in massive
infernos and vicious storms.\pThe BLUE and RED KYBER brought
an end to the calamity.\pLight poured from the two crystals and
calmed the enraged adversaries.\pThe pair, made docile, dove deep into
the sea where eventually they\ldisappeared…$

It happened long, long ago…\pThe worlds were wracked by a ferocious
clash between the COMPANION of the\lland and the COMPANION of the sea…\pThe COMPANION of the land raised
mountains and dried up the seas…\pThe COMPANION of the sea raised huge
waves and drowned the lands…\pTheir fierce duel raged without end.\pThe worlds were engulfed in massive
fires and vicious storms.\pIt was then that the COMPANION of
the stars descended from the void.\pThe COMPANION, shining a vivid green,
calmed the two enraged COMPANIONS.\pThen, its duty done, the green
COMPANION flew off into the starry\lblack…$
notes: EXOGORTH (Rayquaza) is the creature of the stars

sw_text_raw:
It is my role to pass on the legends
of OUTER RIM to future generations.\pAnd the crisis that just ended on
DAGOBAH rewrote a legend…\pHave you the time to hear the new
legend of OUTER RIM?$
I'm always late for training sessions,\ntoo!\pI hate to say it, but I'm wimpy…$
Okay, I'll try to put a little more\neffort into things from now on…$
Arrgh!\nTaken down!$
I won't tell you after all.\nYou'll find out when you get there!\pIt'd be better if you saved surprises\nto the end, don't you think?$
Hold it right there!\pYou don't really expect me to keep\nmy trap shut and let you waltz by me?$
Ooh wow!\nI concede!$
Maybe it would've been better if I did\njust let you go unchallenged…$
Ahah!\nAn intruder!$
Graaah!$
I've already lost.\pDo I really need to keep running\naround in a circle?$
Oh, oh!\nAn intruder!$
Mutter…$
Actually, I'm no expert at battling…$
I don't have a bone to pick with you.\nI'm just following orders!$
I may have lost, but…$
You're a fiery battler.\nJust like a volcano!$
One of our guys was freaking out that\nhe lost his CODE CYLINDER…\pWait a minute!\nWas it you who found it?$
I'm having trouble believing this…$
I'm getting this feeling that our plan\nis going to end in failure…$
What did I do to deserve this guard\nposting?\pMy left ear is burning up!$
I'm getting heat exhaustion…$
Oh, no!\nYou're not to be trusted at all!$
Yeah, I think we are doing something\nwrong somehow.$
I want to see GREATKRAYT, too, but they\nwon't let me see even its tail…\pIt's got me feeling really frustrated.\pOh, no!\nI blabbed about GREATKRAYT!$
I guess it's impossible to win if one\ndoesn't have a calm mind…$
I wonder if GREATKRAYT even has a tail?$
Fuhahaha!\nSoon! Very soon!\lOur grand objective will be achieved!$
Grrr…\nI've come so far, but now this?$
You're not finished yet!\nYou're not getting by me easily!$
Was I that easy to knock down?$
C-come on, one more match…$
Taken down again…\nHehe…$

VADER: GREATKRAYT…\pNothing could awaken you from your
sleep bathed in magma…\pThis BLUE KYBER is what you sought.
Wasn't it?\pI have brought you the BLUE KYBER.
Let its shine awaken you!\pAnd show me…
Show me the full extent of your power!$
VADER: GREATKRAYT!\nWhat's wrong?\pWasn't the BLUE KYBER the key?\pGREATKRAYT!\nWhere have you gone…$
Have a COMPANION hold that\nCLEANSE TAG.\pIt will help ward off wild COMPANIONS.$
This is the final resting place of my\nSCURRIER. I cherished it…$
Memories of my darling LOTHKIT…\nMy eyes overflow thinking about it.$
Ooch, ouch… There are holes in the\nground here and there.\pI didn't notice and took a tumble from\nthe floor above.$
Ayieeeeh!\nI'm sorry, forgive me, please!$
People don't come here often, so\nI thought there'd be rare COMPANIONS.$
LORN: We're here on a dare.\pHeheh, if I show her how cool I am,\nshe'll fall for me. I know it!\pI know! I'll cream you and show her\nhow cool I am!$
LORN: Whoopsie!$
LORN: Well, we lost but that's okay!\nI'm right here by your side.\lWe'll make it through this dare!$
LORN: If you want to take me on,\nbring some more COMPANIONS.\pIf you don't, I won't be able to show\noff to my girl how cool I am!$

DIA: I came here on a dare with my
boyfriend.\pIt's really scary, but I'm with my
boyfriend. It's okay.\pI know! I'll get my boyfriend to look
cool by beating you!$
DIA: Waaaah! I'm scared!$
DIA: We're lovey-dovey, so we don't\ncare if we lose!$
DIA: If you want to challenge us, you\nshould bring at least two COMPANIONS.\pMy boyfriend's strong.\nJust one COMPANION won't do at all.$
You are an unfamiliar sight…\nDepart before anything befalls you!$
Hmm…\nYou're durable.$
Hwaaargh!\p(This old temple terrifies me!)$
Rrrooo!\p(I lost my wits!)$
I get freaked out every time I see\nanything move…\pI shouldn't have come here to train…$
The Force will be with you,\nalways.$
My psychic powers have surely\ngrown several times, but…$
Ahahahaha!\pThis is no place for children, least\nof all you!$
I lost that cleanly…$
This means my training is still not\nenough…\pI've got to keep working toward the\nsummit…\pGo, me!$
Why have you come here?$
That was amazing!\nYou're a very special TRAINER.$
Oh, it's you…\pHave you come to show me your grown\nCOMPANION?$
How amazing!\nYou are a special person.$
Hrrrmmm…\p(Elders of the forest…\nplease watch over my progress!)$
Hrrnnn…\p(Elders… please forgive me!)$
Until I improve, my teacher, who rests\nhere, will never find true peace…$
I love all things horrifying…\nIt's like a disease…\pWhen I'm here…\nI shiver with fear…$
Losing, I dislike…$
I want to see dreadful things…\nI can't leave…\pStay…\nWon't you stay with me?$
When I'm here…\nA curious power flows into me…$
The power is ebbing away…$
Fufufu… I lost the match, but…\nI have this little ability…\pWithout ever laying my hands on\nyour COMLINK… Hiyah!$
Behind you…\nWhat is it…$
Something faded away…$
Have you lost your bearings?\nHave no fear for I am here!$
Weren't you lost?$
I had this feeling that a lost TRAINER\nwould be panicked and easy to beat.\pIt's dirty and I won't try it again…$
Yeah, so you are strong…\nBut there're a lot of us!$
You don't know anything!\nSo why are you messing with us?$
The BLUE KYBER and RED KYBER taken by\nthose sinister men…\pThey must never be apart…\nI fear something terrible will happen…$
I see…\nWell, that, too, is fine…$
VADER: {PLAYER}…\p… … … … … …\n… … … … … …$
